## 1. Test Suite Execution Command

The master test runner is completely self-contained and executes with zero external test framework dependencies using standard Node.js:

```powershell
node demo_video_player/scripts/run_tests.mjs
```

### Supported Execution Flags:
- **Run specific tier:**
  ```powershell
  node demo_video_player/scripts/run_tests.mjs --tier=1   # Feature Coverage (120 tests)
  node demo_video_player/scripts/run_tests.mjs --tier=2   # Boundary & Corner Cases (120 tests)
  node demo_video_player/scripts/run_tests.mjs --tier=3   # Pairwise Combinations (24 tests)
  node demo_video_player/scripts/run_tests.mjs --tier=4   # Real-World Scenarios (12 tests)
  ```
- **Filter tests by name:**
  ```powershell
  node demo_video_player/scripts/run_tests.mjs --filter="HTTP 503"
  ```
- **TAP output format (Test Anything Protocol):**
  ```powershell
  node demo_video_player/scripts/run_tests.mjs --tap
  ```
- **Machine-readable JSON report:**
  ```powershell
  node demo_video_player/scripts/run_tests.mjs --json
  ```
- **Verbose mode (individual test timings):**
  ```powershell
  node demo_video_player/scripts/run_tests.mjs --verbose
  ```

## 4. Test Suite File Index

All test code is strictly partitioned in `demo_video_player/` per architectural ownership:

- `demo_video_player/scripts/run_tests.mjs` — Master test runner orchestrator with CLI flags, TAP/JSON formatters, and summary reporting.
- `demo_video_player/tests/harness.mjs` — High-fidelity mock browser DOM, Web Audio API, timing simulation, assertion library, and contract bridges.
- `demo_video_player/tests/tier1_feature_coverage.test.mjs` — Tier 1 Feature Coverage test suite (120 test cases).
- `demo_video_player/tests/tier2_boundary_corner.test.mjs` — Tier 2 Boundary & Corner Cases test suite (120 test cases).
